name: perl-html-tableextract
description: This tool programmatically parses and extracts data from HTML tables while preserving structural integrity like nested tables and cell spans. Use when user asks to extract data from HTML tables by headers, target tables based on depth or attributes, or handle complex table layouts in Perl.
overview: This skill provides guidance on using the `HTML::TableExtract` Perl module to programmatically parse and retrieve content from HTML tables. Unlike simple regex-based parsing, this tool understands table structures, including nested tables and cell spans (rowspan/colspan). It allows for targeted extraction based on header text, table depth, or tag attributes, and can return data as raw text or as a manipulatable element tree.
